title: Atoms and molecules - 123 school
heading: Atoms and molecules
intro: Only use BINAS when the question names a BINAS table.

questions.question: What is an atom?

answers.a: A mixture of two kinds of molecules
answers.b: A group of molecules that clump together
answers.c: A building block from which molecules are made

questions.question: What is a molecule?

answers.a: A particle made up of two or more atoms
answers.b: The smallest particle of a mixture
answers.c: A substance that consists of one kind of atom and cannot react
answers.d: A particle that consists of one proton

questions.question: What do you call a substance in which all atoms are of the same kind?
What do you call a substance in which the molecules consist of different kinds of atoms?
Is water an element or a compound?

answers.a: An element, because water is a pure substance
answers.b: An element, because water contains only oxygen atoms
answers.c: A mixture, because water contains two kinds of atoms
answers.d: A compound, because a water molecule contains hydrogen and oxygen atoms

questions.question: Is oxygen gas (O<sub>2</sub>) an element or a compound?

answers.a: A compound, because oxygen gas is in the air
answers.b: An element, because the molecule consists of one kind of atom
answers.c: A mixture of oxygen and nitrogen
answers.d: A compound, because the molecule consists of two atoms

questions.question: What is the molecular formula of oxygen gas?
What is the molecular formula of methane?
What is the molecular formula of ammonia?
What does the 2 in H<sub>2</sub>O mean?

answers.a: There are 2 oxygen atoms in the molecule
answers.c: There are 2 hydrogen atoms in the molecule

questions.question: What does the 3 in 3 CO<sub>2</sub> mean?

answers.b: There are 3 oxygen atoms in the molecule
answers.c: There are 3 molecules of carbon dioxide
answers.d: There are 3 carbon atoms in the molecule
